description: A first-order structure \(M\) models an axiom set \(T\) if and only if \(T\subseteq\operatorname{Th}(M)\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Theory.model_iff_subset_completeTheory.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] {T : L.Theory} : M ⊨ T ↔ T ⊆ L.completeTheory M
